en-US.name: EveryList
en-US.summary: Add, remove, and check off items on your self-hosted EveryList lists.
en-US.description:
A private skill for a self-hosted EveryList instance. Add items, mark them done, remove them, and hear (or, on a screen device, see) what's on a list.

Requires:
- A EveryList Self Hosted instance
- OAuth by Authentik
examplePhrases: Alexa, set my default list to Shopping List
Alexa, ask every list to add eggs

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Requires account linking against a self-hosted EveryList instance fronted by Authentik — see alexa/README.md.
